snippet.title: CALL OF CUTIE Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4968940/CALL_OF_CUTIE/

CALL OF CUTIE is a single-player horror adventure set inside a vast, terrifying laboratory. Explore dark corridors, solve puzzles, fight frightening enemies, and rescue the victims trapped inside. Choose your own path with Bubbles and find a way to escape.
